external_audit.opinion: UNQUALIFIED (audit completion certificate withheld pending wider sector arrangements)
key_concerns: Forvis Mazars audited 2023/24 accounts; concluded that Director of Finance's use of the going concern basis was appropriate and no material uncertainties identified
Statement of Accounts 2023/24 approved and authorised for issue under delegation granted at Audit and Governance Committee 27 September 2024
Forvis Mazars LLP could not formally conclude the audit and issue a certificate (procedural - sector-wide backlog issue, not Sunderland-specific)
2024/25 draft Statement of Accounts subject to audit at audit reporting time; presented to Revenue Outturn report to Cabinet 26 June 2025
external_audit.note: Sunderland is one of the cleaner audit cases nationally - Forvis Mazars completed the substantive 2023/24 audit and reported no material uncertainties. Contrast with Thurrock (BDO multi-year disclaimer) and Wakefield (sector-backstop disclaimers 2022/23 + 2023/24).

actionable_savings_levers_summary: £600k 2026/27 savings target is modest relative to peer councils - signals 'Healthy' CIPFA proxy is accurate but reserves drawdown of £9.679m is unsustainable beyond 2-3 years
CQC 'Good' rating with all 9 areas Good = no remediation savings pressure on ASC (contrast with Wakefield 'Requires Improvement') - permits reinvestment of savings into demand prevention
Kier Construction £109.5M top supplier (per task brief) = scope for framework procurement competitive tender review
Together for Children company structure = council-owned arms-length-management vehicle; route to scrutiny of overheads in line with subsidiary review good practice
North East Combined Authority Integrated Settlement = devolution funding stream Sunderland can leverage for transformation
SEND statutory override expiry March 2028 + High Needs Stability Grant eligibility = unknown deficit but available pathway for 90% deficit cover if local plan agreed with DfE
Adult Social Care 2023/24 overspend £4.944m (estimate £124.889m vs actual £129.833m) = budget-vs-actual variance worth investigating for cost control
